method: Eleventh lunch pass - Santa Clara Korean row, downtown San Jose and Cambrian Park. Every field below was transcribed from a page actually retrieved this turn (URL in the row). Nothing was typed from memory. Where a price exists only as a diner quote (Reddit, Yelp Q&A, Yelp review) it is described in the row's includes/flags and left out of the price column, per this project's rule.
